description: This file defines the class PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy, which is a strategy for filtering silo placement based on ordered metadata keys and minimum candidate count within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for initialization and retrieving additional grain properties.

classes.name: PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: A placement filter strategy that filters silos based on ordered metadata keys and minimum candidate count.

methods.name: AdditionalInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with properties, extracting ordered metadata keys and minimum candidates from grain properties.

methods.name: GetAdditionalGrainProperties
methods.description: Returns additional grain properties related to ordered metadata keys and minimum candidates.
